collection.description: A builder wonders whether distant settlements deliberately design routes for people who cannot climb, see, hear, or walk easily.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A builder wonders whether distant settlements deliberately design routes for people who cannot climb, see, hear, or walk easily.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Villagers sketch gentle ramps and clearer paths using available materials.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A craftsperson asks whether a ramp also helps people carrying heavy loads.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A teacher proposes visual signs and tactile markers.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder reminds everyone to ask the intended users what works.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A disabled villager in the imagined discussion rejects being treated as a problem to solve.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The council considers how people with different needs could lead planning rather than merely receive help.
